strict_content_negotiation: Apply strict JSON:API media negotiation; configured channels/default policy still define allowed types.
media_type: Legacy single media type shortcut; null uses the canonical media_types policy.
route_prefix: Default prefix for generated routes; a resource routePrefix overrides it.
resource_paths: Directories for attribute discovery; tagged resource services can also register resources.
data_layer.provider: Built-in Doctrine or explicitly configured custom provider.
data_layer.repository: Custom ResourceRepository service ID; null uses provider wiring.
data_layer.processor: Custom ResourceProcessor service ID; null uses provider wiring.
data_layer.transaction_manager: Custom transaction manager service ID; custom providers own guarantees.
pagination.max_size: Maximum configured page size; positive; independent limits.page_max_size also applies.
write.client_generated_ids: Map of resource types permitting client-generated IDs; unspecified types do not opt in.
relationships.write_response: Return linkage or HTTP 204 after a relationship write.
relationships.linkage_in_resource: Emit embedded linkage always, only on included paths, or never.
relationships.unplanned_read_policy: Legacy getters or reject undeclared relationship loads; custom SQL is application-owned.
errors.expose_debug_meta: Expose configured debugging metadata; leave false for production.
errors.add_correlation_id: Attach correlation identifiers to error responses.
atomic.endpoint: Atomic route path; not derived from route_prefix.
atomic.return_policy: Automatic, no result data, or always return available result data.
atomic.lid.accept_in_resource_and_identi: Accept local IDs in Atomic resource/identifier data; false rejects them.
profiles.enabled_by_default: Global default profile URI list; activated without explicit negotiation.
profiles.per_type: Map resource type to default profile URI lists; activation is type-scoped.
profiles.per_type.<type>: Profile URI list for this literal resource type.
profiles.negotiation.require_known_profi: Reject unknown requested profiles when enabled.
profiles.negotiation.echo_profiles_in_co: Publish activated profile URIs in Content-Type.

profiles.soft_delete.default_visibility: Exclude, include, or show only soft-deleted rows.

profiles.soft_delete.query_flags.only_de: Application query parameter name to show only deleted rows.
profiles.soft_delete.delete_semantics: Soft mark or physical delete while the profile is active.
profiles.audit_trail.created_at: Creation time property; attribute overrides are supported.
profiles.audit_trail.updated_at: Update time property; attribute overrides are supported.

profiles.audit_trail.updated_by: Update actor property; null disables it.
profiles.audit_trail.expose_in_meta: Expose configured audit values in resource.meta.audit.
profiles.rel_counts.relationship_meta_ke: Non-empty relationship metadata key for computed counts.
profiles.rel_counts.compute_in_related_e: Compute/publish relationship counts on related endpoints.
media_types.default.request.allowed: Allowed incoming media types for this policy.
media_types.default.response.default: Default response media type when no accepted alternative is selected.
media_types.channels.<name>.request.allo: Allowed incoming media types for this policy.
media_types.channels.<name>.response.def: Default response media type when no accepted alternative is selected.
media_types.channels: Map of named media policies; route/channel scope chooses overrides.
media_types.channels.<name>.scope.path_p: Match a URL prefix; null leaves this matcher unspecified.
media_types.channels.<name>.scope.route_: Route-name regular expression; null leaves it unspecified.
media_types.channels.<name>.scope.attrib: MediaChannel attribute regular expression; null leaves it unspecified.
cache.etag.strategy: Hash representation or use application-provided version validator without hash fallback.
cache.etag.hash_algo: PHP hash algorithm used for hash strategy.
cache.etag.include_query_shape: Include representation query shape in generated validator input.
cache.last_modified.collections_max_of: Synthesize collection Last-Modified from resource maxima; false omits it.
cache.headers.public: Public versus private cache policy; applications own authorization/variation.
cache.headers.max_age: Browser freshness in seconds; zero is zero seconds.
cache.headers.stale_while_revalidate: Permitted stale interval while revalidating, in seconds.
cache.headers.stale_if_error: Permitted stale interval on error, in seconds.
cache.surrogate_keys.enabled: Publish surrogate keys; purge infrastructure is application-owned.
cache.surrogate_keys.format.resource: Template for resource key, using type/id.
cache.surrogate_keys.format.collection: Template for collection key, using type.
cache.surrogate_keys.format.relationship: Template for relationship key, using type/id/rel.
cache.conditional.enable_if_match: Evaluate If-Match on writes; Doctrine guard protects current root.
cache.conditional.require_if_match_on_wr: Require If-Match on update/delete; missing header returns 428.
limits.include_max_depth: Maximum include path depth; zero disables.
limits.filter_max_depth: Maximum structural/raw filter depth before SQL; zero disables.
limits.filter_max_nodes: Maximum AST nodes before SQL; zero disables.
limits.filter_max_operands: Maximum operands including every IN/NOT IN value; zero disables.
limits.include_max_paths: Maximum distinct include paths; zero disables.
limits.fields_max_total: Maximum requested sparse fields across types; zero disables.
limits.page_max_size: Independent hard requested page-size limit; zero disables this guard only.
limits.included_max_resources: Maximum included identities, reserved before native hydration; zero disables.
limits.relationship_max_identifiers: Maximum relationship identifiers per document/standalone linkage; zero disables.
limits.complexity_budget: Weighted include/fields/page/filter complexity budget; zero disables.
performance.doctrine.collection_sort_pol: Legacy joined to-many ordering or reject without an explicit aggregate sort handler.
performance.head_enabled: Enable generated HEAD; false rejects HEAD and omits it from OPTIONS.
